### Added

* **qBittorrent** — download speed, active downloads, and seeding count (Web UI `username|password`)
* **Bazarr** — missing subtitle counts for episodes and movies (API key)

### Improved

* **Integration widgets on hover** — Prowlarr, *arr, qBittorrent, Bazarr, etc. show stats when you hover the card (keeps cards compact; RSS feeds unchanged)
* **Host telemetry mapping docs** — guide for finding network interface names and disk mounts, linked from Settings → Privacy & Access

### Install / Upgrade

Proxmox / bare metal:

```bash
curl -sSL https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/releases/latest/download/update-amud.sh | bash
```

Docker / Unraid: pull latest image and restart **AMUD-Dashboard** and **AMUD-Agent**.

Hard-refresh the dashboard (`Ctrl+Shift+R`) after upgrade. **Settings → System** should show `v1.5.5.1`.
